notes:
v4.6.24 — Tools tab API-key dropdowns refresh for new bots

🐛 FIXED
• Tools → ALPACA · API KEYS → 'Assigned' dropdown didn't show newly-created custom bots. The dropdown was built once at app startup from the bot registry snapshot and never refreshed. Users had to restart APEX after each new bot to assign a key slot.

✨ NEW
• Bot registry refresh now wired to TWO triggers:
  1. Automatic — every time a bot is added or removed (More Bots Add/Remove buttons), the Tools tab's slot Assigned dropdowns get re-populated. Newly-active bots appear instantly.
  2. Manual — '↻ Reload bots' button next to the ALPACA · API KEYS header. Click it after saving a bot via Make Bot to surface it in the dropdown without restarting.
• Current dropdown selection is preserved when the list rebuilds — your existing slot assignments don't get reset.
